[Thinking]
**Providing email acknowledgment templates**

The user's looking for ways to email back to acknowledge receipt. I think they might want examples or templates for various scenarios like formal, informal, or even urgent responses. I’ll keep my guidance brief and include multiple short templates for different situations, ensuring to cover subject lines as well. It would also be good to provide optional phrases to give them more flexibility. Let’s get started on crafting those templates!
[/Thinking]

Here are short, professional ways to reply when you want to acknowledge an email. Use whichever tone fits the sender (formal, neutral, or casual).

Subject line ideas
- Re: [Original subject] — Received
- Acknowledgement: [Original subject]
- Thanks — I received this

Short templates

1) Formal / professional
Thank you for your email. I have received it and will review the details. I will get back to you by [day/time] with a response.  
Best regards,  
[Your name]

2) Neutral / quick acknowledgement
Thanks — I’ve received your message and will follow up shortly.  
Thanks,  
[Your name]

3) Casual / internal team
Got it — thanks! I’ll take care of this and update you by [when].  
-[Your name]

4) When you need more time
Thank you for sending this. I’ve received it and need a bit more time to review. I’ll respond with a full update by [date/time].  
Regards,  
[Your name]

5) Confirming receipt of an attachment
I received your email and the attached [document name]. I’ll review it and reply by [when]. Thanks.  
[Your name]

6) If you only want to acknowledge and nothing else
Received, thank you.  
[Your name]

Useful short phrases you can mix in
- "I have received your email."
- "Thank you — I’m on it."
- "Noted with thanks."
- "I’ll follow up by [time/date]."

Keep it brief and include a next step or timeline if action is expected. Want a version tailored to a specific situation? Tell me the context and tone.
